features: Shell S15 (BL-009): 394 mm full-width box tapering to 360 mm at the collar seam, depth 160 / 205 mm, collar seam z 745; plus a 30 mm top setback (second Z-fold in B-01, z 631-745) that holds the bag top back for R-28 at 23 in
Team B fabrics: ULTRAGrid body and hem, 70D collar, ULTRA 200X floor, ULTRA 200 frame panel; each swap carries its fabric_swap_evidence gate
Two door options to the same level: D1 floor-hinged full-face tailgate (team C, lid straps H1-H3) and D2 camo-blade door (team E rule on S15's square corners: panel line = camo break = zip)
Team A hip-reach pockets FP-L / FP-R on the gussets (snacks + GPS left, 2nd bottle right) and the pole quiver
Straps BL-003 REC: IM1-IM3 and US1/US2 at 25 mm, sewn loops girth-hitched on the IM eyes; no wings: W1-W3 are the only external straps (compression, tripod, float wrap)
Attachment BL-004 REC: no crown hood, no ladders, no IM2 bag hooks; guys toggled round the top bar (bright toggle + hang-tag: 'guys on' is a carry rule); B-17 70 mm
BL-010 hardware: 22 g wiregate carabiners at the IM3 bag hooks, IM3 meat free end and B-24; rated G-hooks and heavy ladder locks on W1-W3 and the guys
Add-ons outside base: scope pod (left gusset), top pouch 2.7 L, rain fly (base pocket stays), meat liner (team D SWAP slab), float kit B-24; bottle holster is a belt add-on
Quiet: no hook-and-loop, coil zips, solid colours with camo on the blades / flaps, kick bands and FP mouth bands
risks: Mass goal missed: like-for-like saving 245 g (D2) against the 350 g target; base-to-base 336 g (section 2 of the write-up names each shortfall)
Fabric gates: ULTRAGrid swatch (owner), ULTRA 200X PT-3 + 50 mm strip test, 70D stock weighed; with today's fabrics the saving drops by about 60 g

Hip-reach pocket reach on S15 is an ASSUMPTION (team A's EV-3): the mouth sits on the gusset at x +/-197, outside A's 320 mm base; FP-R, the tripod under W1/W2 and the bow cam cup IMP-8 share the right gusset (fit check)
S15 is 16-17 in wide loaded at hip and elbow height (BL-009 gate: elbow swing and rifle-sling check)
R-28 at 23 in rests on the 30 mm top setback (sim) and the corrected method (attach_system design_face); protractor check on the first prototype at the L crown kit
'Guys on' is a carry rule: without them the 15 in meat CG exceeds rev C (BL-004)
D2: the zip runs beside a 630D camo blade on a square corner (no fold, unlike E's chamfer) - untested; D1: the lid drops to the ground and needs H1-H3 cinched before zipping (procedure)
Coarse-mesh CG (h 40 mm); the closed door is modelled on CORRIE's cut lines for both options (ASSUMPTION DOOR-SIM)
